negativeCases.expected: NaN, missing, string and rounding inputs fail closed
divergent canonical Goal lineage is rejected
crash/redelivery/last-attempt cannot duplicate effect or create false DLQ
late replay after retention cannot recreate inbound processing
self-declared digest or missing replay CRUD fails startup
stale critic/report/mutant cannot qualify current candidate
other-commit image, root image or embedded secret fails supply gate
unsafe or agent-only holdout result fails qualification
runtime telemetry gap, sensitive sink or uncorrelated alert fails
configured readiness, restart/replay or PostgreSQL skip fails compose gate
synthetic/external fixture cannot satisfy human/external gate

verdictRules: Any required gate not PASS blocks the corresponding seal.
Evidence is current only when candidateId, tree and artifact digests match the live frozen candidate.
Historical coherence never qualifies the current candidate.
No average, score or stored status overrides a required failure.
Local controlled PASS never implies staging or production authorization.
Changing this bar reopens dependent tasks and requires a new version and review.
